TinyMCE 4.9.11 "table" plugin (official build, LGPL-2.1), from
https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/tinymce/4.9.11/plugins/table/plugin.min.js

WordPress bundles TinyMCE 4.9.11 without its table plugin; this file adds the
Table button to the classic editor (product descriptions). Keep it on the same
version as WordPress's TinyMCE.
